text:
anya: heads-up — CI alert for BERTScore crossed threshold on quant-int8 run for model redwood/llama-7b-q4a. keeps flapping :face_with_thermometer:

matt: saw that. is it metric drift or a scoring bug?

eva: looks like normalization in our BERTScore impl changed after PR #342 — cosine vs idf-weighted. CI threshold was tuned for old behavior.

anya: exact. pass@k and exact_match unaffected, ROUGE/BLEU stable. only BERTScore baseline dropped ~0.12 vs baseline.

liz: could be tokenization mismatch with the quantized tokenizer — token ids -> wrong embeddings. also saw embedding dim warnings locally.

anya: here's snippet from eval-runner logs:
```
2026-03-19 11:12:03 eval-runner INFO: computed bertscore=0.743 for sample 204
2026-03-19 11:12:03 eval-runner WARN: embedding shape mismatch: (512,) vs (768,) — using fallback
```

matt: embedding shape mismatch is a red flag — likely the runner picked CPU embedder variant when GPU quantized model was requested under load.

ci-bot: alert: eval-suite/bertscore-regression detected (run 2026-03-19T11:12:03Z). Threshold exceeded: delta=-0.12 vs baseline

eva: hypothesis: new scorer PR normalized per-batch which biases short sequences downward. also found runner bug that double-counts some example ids, shifting the mean.

anya: proposed actions:
- revert normalization to per-example (eva)
- add unit test for tokenization + embedding shapes (liz)
- change CI alerting to use delta vs baseline (percent diff) instead of absolute fixed threshold (matt)
- patch eval-runner to dedup sample ids before aggregation (anya)

liz: pushed branch fix/bertscore-token-dedup, added a small tokenizer roundtrip test. CI link: https://ci.company/gh/redwood/eval/pulls/58

matt: will update alerting logic to use percent-diff and add a Grafana panel comparing current run vs baseline per-metric. also adding `--strict` flag to runner to fail on embedding-shape mismatch.

anya: FYI dashboard reporting was aggregating by run_id not model_name which made spikes noisy — fixed in PR that groups by model+dataset.

eva: long-term: we should maintain per-dataset thresholds and confidence intervals; include pass@k and exact_match into a composite quality signal. ROUGE/BLEU are useful but less sensitive here.

anya: scheduling quick postmortem in eng-ml tomorrow 10:00am.

matt: LGTM. @ci-bot can you schedule a re-run after fixes?

ci-bot: scheduled re-run: eval-suite/bertscore-regression at 2026-03-19T12:10:00Z :white_check_mark:

liz: local smoke run: `./scripts/run_eval --model redwood/llama-7b-q4a --suite bertscore-regression --seed 42` shows BERTScore back to baseline after token fix.

anya: great — will close incident when CI green.

ci-bot: run completed: PASS (delta -0.01) — posting report to https://grafana.company/alerts/1234

anya: thanks everyone. follow-ups: PR for per-example normalization (eva), CI alerting change (matt), runner dedup + strict flag (anya).
